examples.text: Im Lazarett wurden wir als erstes entlaust.

glosses: To apply insecticides or insect repellents to, in order to be sure that no lice or other parasites are present.

examples.text: During the Korean Conflict, American soldiers were deloused with DDT upon entering basic training.

glosses: To remove malicious software, such as viruses, trojans, spyware, or worms, from.

examples.text: A deloused computer may still be considered no longer trustworthy.
